name: Northern Kentucky University
academic_ranking: Public university; ~10,300 undergraduates (fall 2024), total enrollment ~15,370. Open-access admissions with an acceptance rate around 90%. Organized into seven colleges including the Haile College of Business, College of Informatics, and Salmon P. Chase College of Law. National rankings: U.S. News & World Report #382 (tie), Forbes #640, Washington Monthly #338.
financial_aid: Public tuition varies by residency: approximately $11,088/year for Kentucky residents and $21,912/year for out-of-state students (2024-25). About 30% of students are Pell grant (low-income) recipients. NCAA D1 athletic scholarships available for softball; combine athletic aid with academic and need-based aid.
facilities_notes: NKU softball plays home games at Bill Aker Softball Field on the Highland Heights campus. Specific capacity and feature details were not confirmed on the live facilities page (checked 2026-07).
program_reputation: NCAA Division I program competing in the Horizon League. Represents Northern Kentucky University in the Cincinnati metropolitan area.
notes: Researched 2026-07 from live nkunorse.com softball staff and roster pages plus NKU/enrollment sources. Coaching staff directory lists four coaches (head coach + three assistants); no director of operations, graduate assistants, or volunteer staff were listed. Roster page listed 20 players. Only two coach emails were publicly posted. Team X/Twitter account is @NKUNorseSB. Tuition value stored is out-of-state; in-state noted in financial_aid. scholarship_count not publicly published.
